about.text: Kefir is a fermented milk drink similar to a thin yogurt or ayran that is made from kefir grains, a specific type of mesophilic symbiotic culture. It is prepared by inoculating the milk of cows, goats, or sheep with kefir grains.

facts.v: Cow's, goat's or sheep's; 0.5–6 % fat, often 2.5–3.5 %
Viscous, shiny, slightly fizzy; yeasts are 5–10 % of the microflora
The Caucasus; made by natural fermentation or by back-slopping with grains
Grains (2–5% of the milk) ferment it 12–24 h at 20–25 °C; the grains are strained out and reused
Traditional grain kefir has about 0.2–2% alcohol from the yeasts; factory kefir uses a bacteria and yeast blend instead of grains
In artisanal grains from Athens and Crete, Lactobacillus kefiranofaciens made up about 95% of the bacteria
